moc: Old St Paul's ruined Gothic tower without dome (through the window, if visible)

ghi_chu.mo_ta: A thin, isolated obelisk or column stands on the far skyline at the right of centre. It looks like the Monument to the Great Fire.
ghi_chu.ly_do: The Monument was built in 1671–77, after the Great Fire. It did not exist in 1666.

ghi_chu.mo_ta: No large ruined Gothic tower of Old St Paul's is visible on the skyline. The skyline shows only small, thin spires and a long crenellated wall.
ghi_chu.ly_do: In 1666 the ruined, roofless, domeless Old St Paul's tower had to stand prominently in this view, and it is absent.
